# Čech–Picard dictionary: homomorphism direction landed (2026-07-12, run 0027 s0018)

**Landed axiom-clean** (`propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound`, full build 8607 jobs):
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.toPic : X.CechPic →* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)` for affine `X`,
plus `toPic_injective` and computation rule `toPic_mk` (`Picard/CechPicToPic.lean`).  This is
half of the Item-5 dictionary of [[etale-plus-lane-recipes]] (design:
`informal/pic-affine-dictionary-design.md`) and literally a mathlib TODO in
`RingTheory/PicardGroup.lean`.

**Architecture (all files sorry-free, ≤ 500 lines each):**
- `Descent/UnitDescent(+Map).lean`: `Module.IsDescentCocycle u` (normalized unit 1-cocycle in
  `(B ⊗[A] B)ˣ`) → `DescentDatum.ofUnit` (coaction `x ↦ u·(x⊗1)`) → descended invertible module →
  `picClass` calculus: one/mul (via `distribBaseChange`+`equivDescended`), coboundary invariance,
  `picClass_eq_one_iff` (trivial ⟺ coboundary; unit = image of a generator via `descentEquiv`
  bijectivity), `picClass_map` (base change along maps of FF algebras via `cancelBaseChange`).
- `Algebra/PiLocalization.lean`: **pi-ext lemma** `AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi` (A-algebra
  maps out of finite products of localizations agree if equal on `Pi.single i 1`; proof via
  unital corner maps into `C ⧸ span{1-ε}` + `IsLocalization.ringHom_ext` + idempotent
  multiplication), `FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_span_eq_top`, pi/tensor AlgEquivs, `Away.tensor'`
  (A-relative `f*g`).
- `Algebra/LocalizationCocycle(+Refine).lean`: `IsCoverCocycle` on `S i/T i j/W i j k` Away-model
  families; `cocycleUnit` via `piDouble/TripleEquiv`; ALL simplicial-map transports proved by the
  pi-ext idempotent method (never unfold `algHomOfDvd`—only uniqueness); coboundary
  detection/construction; `picClass_eq_of_coboundary`, `picClass_map_refine`.
- `Picard/PicAffineCover.lean`: `PointedCover.BasicRefinement` (index type is a `Type u` FIELD so
  merges are `P.ι × Q.ι`; existence via `IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le` + compactness);
  `coverCocycle` = restricted `unitsEvInf`; canonical maps = presheaf restrictions by
  `basicOpen_algHom_ext` (= `IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton`); scheme-side instances are ALL
  mathlib's (`isLocalization_away_of_isAffine`, `algebra_section_section_basicOpen`) — zero glue.
- `Picard/PicAffine.lean`: three comparison moves (restriction `pic_ofLE` on-the-nose;
  cohomologous `pic_eq_of_isCohomologous`; merge `pic_interFst`/`pic_inter`/bridge) ⇒ master
  `pic_congr` ⇒ everything choice-independent.  `Picard/FamilyCoboundary.lean`: glued-coboundary
  generalized to arbitrary refining families (ported verbatim from RefinementInjectivity).

**Recipes (hard-won):**
- **Pi-ext idempotent method**: any identity between A-algebra maps out of `∏(localizations)`
  = evaluate on `Pi.single i 1`; forward images forced (`piDoubleEquiv (single i 1 ⊗ single j 1)
  = single (i,j) 1`); symm-values via `AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq`. Replaces ALL naturality diagrams.
- **Definition-site rfl interface**: `pic`-style defs wrapping big instance towers are defeq-
  EXPENSIVE; `exact`/`rfl` against them times out ANYWHERE except at the definition site. Provide
  `pic_eq_picClass : P.pic γ = @picClass … P.faithfullyFlat … := rfl` NEXT TO the def, consumers
  `rw` it first. (`refine` unifies at reducible and always fails on such defs; use `exact`.)
- **Proof-irrelevant atom walls**: `group`/`ring`/`rw` treat `unitsRestrict h₁ x` vs
  `unitsRestrict h₂ x` (different le-proofs) as DIFFERENT atoms though defeq. Fixes: align
  spellings with `rw [show A = B from rfl]` (rfl checks by proof irrelevance), or finish with
  `exact` (full defeq). `group` does NOT use commutativity — for `a*(b*a⁻¹)=b` use
  `rw [mul_comm, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]`.
- **Structure-update sharing**: to compare two structure instances differing in one field
  (interFst vs inter: same ι, r; different pt), define one as `{ other with pt := … }` so shared
  fields are the SAME projection terms — kills defeq grind in family arguments.
- **`{A}` implicit + instance-arg families**: calls like `AwayCover.diag` NEED `(A := …)` named
  or TC search with metavariable head thrashes into whnf timeouts.
- **lean-lsp staleness**: after rebuilding imported oleans the open file-worker does NOT reload
  imports ("Imports are out of date"); `touch` doesn't help; use `lake env lean <file>` CLI or
  the mcp lean_build restart. Parallel subagents + main loop on one LSP = frequent staleness.
- `MulEquiv.piUnits` unusable through our import chain — use a direct `Pi.unitOf` constructor
  (definitionally transparent val/inv) instead.
- ι-universe: descent machinery pins `Type u` modules ⟹ index types must be `Type u`
  (subcover indexed by subtypes of X-points); PiLocalization kept `Type v` polymorphic.

**Next** (in order): (1) surjectivity — invertible module trivializes on a basic cover via
`Module.FinitePresentation.exists_lift_equiv_of_isLocalizedModule` at primes + `Pic(local)=0`,
`toPic` of the transition cocycle = `Pic.mk M` by `equivDescended`; gives
`cechPicEquivPic : X.CechPic ≃* CommRing.Pic Γ(X,⊤)`. (2) Naturality in `X` (needed by the C1
assembly along `Spec B → Spec A` étale covers). (3) The (C1) étale-separatedness assembly per
design §4.4 item 5. (4) Blueprint section (deferred per the brick-precedent of

`UnitDescent` calculus are prime ForMathlib/ extraction candidates (Phase 2).
